newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Telkom opposed to telephone price cuts.
newsitem.headline: Telkom opposed to telephone price cuts.

text.p: Indonesia's PT Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Telkom) said on Thursday it had urged the government not to allow long distance telephone prices to be cut.
"In a very short time, the board of directors will propose to the government not to allow (a) price cut," director Dadad Kustiwa told analysts.

Telkom said the government had started to allow cellular operators to provide long distance services and they would be providing competition for Telkom. This could affect the company's financial performance.
Kustiwa said he believed cellular telephone operators would use Telkom's infrastructure rather than build their own.
